fact: The Official Bulletin of 5 April 2026 publishes the Regulations under the Data Protection Act, which assign the Data Protection Authority (Hay'adda Dhowrista Xogta) the registration of data controllers and processors.
title: Xeer-nidaamiyaha Sharciga Dhowrista Xogta Dadweynaha
publisher: Faafinta Rasmiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya (Official Bulletin)
